articles.title: UK Bakes in Hottest May Day Ever — Donkeys Get the Day Off!
articles.summary: The UK hit a scorching 34.8°C on Monday — the hottest May day ever recorded. Even donkeys at a derby got to stay home because of the heat. Some places might reach 35°C.

articles.title: Pope Says Sorry for Church's Part in Slavery — A First in History!
articles.summary: Pope Leo XIV made a historic apology on Monday for the Vatican's role in allowing slavery centuries ago. He said past popes gave rulers permission to enslave people, and called it a 'wound in Christian memory.'

articles.title: 1.5 Million Pilgrims Begin Hajj in Saudi Arabia's Scorching Heat
articles.summary: Over 1.5 million Muslims from around the world have arrived in Mecca for the Hajj pilgrimage. They are braving intense heat and regional tensions, but many say the journey is a dream come true.
